# Drawer

A panel that slides in from any edge of the screen. Built on Radix Dialog for focus trap, scroll lock and a11y; tuned for mobile with full-bleed side panels, a bottom-sheet grab handle, and swipe-to-dismiss.

```tsx
<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger asChild>
    <Button>Open drawer</Button>
  </DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent side="right">
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Notifications</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>You're all caught up.</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerBody>{/* … */}</DrawerBody>
    <DrawerFooter>
      <DrawerClose asChild>
        <Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>
      </DrawerClose>
      <Button>Mark all read</Button>
    </DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add drawer
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/drawer/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader,
  DrawerBody, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerClose,
} from "@/components/ui/drawer"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Drawer>
      <DrawerTrigger asChild>
        <Button>Open drawer</Button>
      </DrawerTrigger>
      <DrawerContent side="right">
        <DrawerHeader>
          <DrawerTitle>Notifications</DrawerTitle>
          <DrawerDescription>You're all caught up.</DrawerDescription>
        </DrawerHeader>
        <DrawerBody>{/* … */}</DrawerBody>
        <DrawerFooter>
          <DrawerClose asChild>
            <Button variant="ghost">Close</Button>
          </DrawerClose>
          <Button>Mark all read</Button>
        </DrawerFooter>
      </DrawerContent>
    </Drawer>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
import {
  Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription,
  DrawerBody, DrawerFooter, DrawerClose, DrawerNav, DrawerView, DrawerNavBack, DrawerNavTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/drawer"

<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger />
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle />
      <DrawerDescription />
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerBody />
    <DrawerFooter>
      <DrawerClose />
    </DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

{/* With in-sheet navigation */}
<DrawerContent>
  <DrawerNav>
    <DrawerView>
      <DrawerHeader>
        <DrawerNavBack />
        <DrawerTitle />
      </DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerBody>
        <DrawerNavTrigger />
      </DrawerBody>
    </DrawerView>
  </DrawerNav>
</DrawerContent>
```

## Sides

`side` on `DrawerContent` picks the edge the panel slides from: `top`, `right` (default), `bottom`, or `left`. Top and bottom render as sheets with a grab handle; left and right as full-height panels. Every variant animates with the dedicated `ease-drawer` curve.

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="top">…</DrawerContent>
<DrawerContent side="right">…</DrawerContent>  {/* default */}
<DrawerContent side="bottom">…</DrawerContent>
<DrawerContent side="left">…</DrawerContent>
```

## Mobile: bottom sheet

On touch devices the bottom sheet is the native pattern. It rounds its top corners, shows a grab handle, and pads past the home-indicator safe area. It is **swipe-to-dismiss** by default. Drag the handle or header down and release past ~45% (or flick) to close, handing the exit animation back to Radix. The drag only arms after a few pixels, so taps on the rows still register, and it never starts on the scrollable body, so a drag and a scroll never fight. Disable it with `swipeToClose={false}`.

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="bottom" showClose={false}>
  <DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerTitle>Project roadmap</DrawerTitle>
    <DrawerDescription>Choose an action for this document.</DrawerDescription>
  </DrawerHeader>
  <DrawerBody>
    {actions.map((a) => (
      <DrawerClose asChild key={a.label}>
        <button className="…">{a.icon}{a.label}</button>
      </DrawerClose>
    ))}
  </DrawerBody>
</DrawerContent>
```

## Navigate inside the sheet

A bottom sheet often needs to drill into nested views (an action sheet that opens a sub-panel, a settings menu, a multi-step filter) without ever leaving the sheet. Wrap the pages in `DrawerNav` and give each a `DrawerView`: only the active view renders, it enters with a native horizontal push (from the right going forward, the left on back), and the sheet's height animates to fit it. A `DrawerNavTrigger` drills in; a `DrawerNavBack` (which renders nothing at the root, so you can place it in a shared header) pops. The stack resets when the sheet closes, and swipe-down still dismisses the whole sheet from any view.

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="bottom" showClose={false}>
  <DrawerNav defaultView="root">
    <DrawerView view="root">
      <DrawerHeader className="flex-row items-center gap-1">
        <DrawerNavBack />            {/* hidden at the root */}
        <DrawerTitle>Settings</DrawerTitle>
      </DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerBody>
        <DrawerNavTrigger view="notifications" asChild>
          <button className="…">Notifications <CaretRight /></button>
        </DrawerNavTrigger>
      </DrawerBody>
    </DrawerView>

    <DrawerView view="notifications">
      <DrawerHeader className="flex-row items-center gap-1">
        <DrawerNavBack />
        <DrawerTitle>Notifications</DrawerTitle>
      </DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerBody>{/* toggles… */}</DrawerBody>
    </DrawerView>
  </DrawerNav>
</DrawerContent>
```

## Form panel

A right-side panel is the desktop home for an edit form; it keeps the underlying page visible for context. Compose labelled [Input](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/input.md) parts in the `DrawerBody` and land focus on the first field with `onOpenAutoFocus`.

```tsx
<DrawerContent
  side="right"
  onOpenAutoFocus={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); nameRef.current?.focus() }}
>
  <DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerTitle>Edit profile</DrawerTitle>
    <DrawerDescription>Update your details.</DrawerDescription>
  </DrawerHeader>
  <DrawerBody>
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
        <InputLabel htmlFor="name">Full name</InputLabel>
        <InputRoot><InputField ref={nameRef} id="name" /></InputRoot>
      </div>
      {/* … */}
    </div>
  </DrawerBody>
  <DrawerFooter>
    <DrawerClose asChild><Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button></DrawerClose>
    <DrawerClose asChild><Button>Save changes</Button></DrawerClose>
  </DrawerFooter>
</DrawerContent>
```

## Navigation menu

A left drawer makes a compact, off-canvas navigation menu for small screens. The `DrawerBody` scrolls independently while the header and footer stay pinned; each link is wrapped in `DrawerClose` so picking one dismisses the panel.

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="left" size="sm">
  <DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerTitle>Koala</DrawerTitle>
    <DrawerDescription>Workspace navigation</DrawerDescription>
  </DrawerHeader>
  <DrawerBody>
    <nav className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      {items.map((i) => (
        <DrawerClose asChild key={i.label}>
          <a href={i.href} className="…">{i.icon}{i.label}</a>
        </DrawerClose>
      ))}
    </nav>
  </DrawerBody>
  <DrawerFooter className="sm:justify-start">…</DrawerFooter>
</DrawerContent>
```

## Sizes

`size` caps the panel's cross-axis extent: the *width* of left/right panels and the *height* of top/bottom sheets. Panels stay full-bleed below the cap, so on a phone they fill the screen and on desktop they settle into a panel. Four steps: `sm`, `md` (default), `lg`, `xl`.

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="right" size="sm">…</DrawerContent>
<DrawerContent side="right" size="md">…</DrawerContent>  {/* default */}
<DrawerContent side="right" size="lg">…</DrawerContent>
<DrawerContent side="bottom" size="lg">…</DrawerContent>  {/* caps height */}
```

## Density

Drawers are `compact` unless a `DensityProvider` or `density="comfortable"` opens them up: 24px padding and an 18px title instead of 16px and 16px. The content re-provides its density to the header, body and footer so every part stays in sync. Best driven once via `DensityProvider`. See [Density](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/foundations/density.md).

```tsx
<DrawerContent side="right" density="comfortable">…</DrawerContent>
```

## API reference

### Drawer

The root, Radix `Dialog.Root`; renders no DOM. Every part that renders an element accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled open state. |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Initial open state when uncontrolled. |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the drawer opens or closes, including by a swipe. |
| modal | boolean | true | Trap focus, lock scroll and hide the rest of the page from screen readers while open. |

### DrawerTrigger

Opens the drawer, Radix `Dialog.Trigger`. Renders a `<button>` and forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element (a `Button`) instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`. |

### DrawerContent

The panel, Radix `Dialog.Content` portalled to the body with its own scrim; forwards all its props. Re-provides its density to every part inside.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| side | "top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" | "right" | The edge it slides from. Top and bottom are sheets with a grab handle; left and right are full-height panels. |
| size | "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" | "md" | Caps the width of a side panel (`max-w-sm` to `max-w-xl`) or the height of a sheet (40 to 92dvh). |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | "compact" | 24px padding with an 18px title, or 16px with a 16px title. Falls back to the nearest `DensityProvider`. |
| swipeToClose | boolean | true | Drag the handle or header toward the edge to dismiss: past about 45% of the panel, or on a flick. |
| showHandle | boolean | true | Show the grab handle on `top` and `bottom` sheets. |
| showClose | boolean | true | Render the built-in top-right close button. |
| closeLabel | string | "Close" | Accessible label of the built-in close button. |
| onOpenAutoFocus | (event: Event) => void | - | Called as focus moves in on open; `preventDefault()` and focus your first field instead. |
| onCloseAutoFocus | (event: Event) => void | - | Called as focus returns to the trigger on close. |
| onEscapeKeyDown | (event: KeyboardEvent) => void | - | Called on Escape; `preventDefault()` keeps the drawer open. |
| onInteractOutside | (event: Event) => void | - | Called on a pointer down or focus outside the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps it open. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `"open"` or `"closed"`, on the panel and on the scrim. |
| data-side | The resolved `side`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --surface | Set to `var(--popover)`, read by nested Inputs and Selects. |

### DrawerHeader

The title block at the panel's edge, and a drag region for swipe-to-dismiss. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### DrawerTitle

The heading the drawer is announced by, Radix `Dialog.Title` (an `<h2>`). Required for accessibility; hide it with `sr-only` when the design has none.

### DrawerDescription

Muted supporting copy, Radix `Dialog.Description` (a `<p>`).

### DrawerBody

The region between header and footer that scrolls on its own; a swipe never starts here. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### DrawerFooter

The action row pinned to the panel's far edge: stacked and reversed on mobile, right-aligned from `sm`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### DrawerClose

Closes the drawer, Radix `Dialog.Close`. Renders a `<button>` and forwards all its props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own element (a footer `Button`, a nav link) instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

### DrawerNav

An in-sheet navigation stack holding `DrawerView` pages; its height animates to the active one and it resets each time the drawer opens. Forwards all native `<div>` props except `onChange`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| defaultView* | string | - | The view shown when the drawer opens. |
| onViewChange | (view: string) => void | - | Called whenever the active view changes, on a push or a pop. |

### DrawerView

One page in the stack, rendered only while active; it pushes in from the right going forward and from the left on back. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| view* | string | - | The id this page is shown for. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-direction | `"forward"` or `"back"` after the first navigation; absent on the first view. |

### DrawerNavTrigger

Pushes a view onto the stack when clicked, unless your `onClick` calls `preventDefault()`. Forwards all native `<button>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| view* | string | - | The `DrawerView` to open. |
| asChild | boolean | false | Merge onto your own row or button instead of rendering a `<button>`. |

### DrawerNavBack

An icon button that pops the stack; renders nothing at the root view, so it can sit in a shared header. Forwards all native `<button>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string | "Back" | Accessible label. |
| children | React.ReactNode | - | Replaces the default caret glyph. |

### useDrawerNav

A hook for driving the stack from anywhere inside a `DrawerNav`, e.g. after an async action. Returns `{ activeView, canGoBack, navigate(view), back() }`.

## FAQ

### When should I use a Drawer instead of a Dialog?

Both are built on Radix Dialog, but reach for a Drawer when the panel should slide in from a screen edge: a right-side edit form that keeps the page visible, a left off-canvas nav, or a mobile bottom sheet. Use Dialog for a centered, modal confirmation or focused task that does not belong to an edge.

### Drawer or Sheet?

A Drawer interrupts: it opens over the page, dims it, traps focus and closes when the task is done. For a panel that stays open next to the page for as long as it is open, like the place list over a map or the layers of a design board, use the Sheet (/docs/components/sheet): it never dims or traps, and it turns into a bottom sheet with detents on a narrow container.

### What does the side prop on DrawerContent control?

It picks the edge the panel slides from: `top`, `right` (the default), `bottom`, or `left`. Left and right render as full-height panels, while top and bottom render as sheets with a grab handle and rounded inner corners.

### How does swipe-to-dismiss work and can I turn it off?

Swipe-to-dismiss is on by default: drag the handle or header toward the closing edge and release past about 45 percent (or flick) to close, which hands the exit animation back to Radix. The drag only arms after a few pixels of slop and never starts on the scrollable DrawerBody, so taps and scrolling still work. Disable it with `swipeToClose={false}`.

### Where does focus go when a drawer opened by state closes?

With a DrawerTrigger, focus returns to the trigger. Without one (a drawer opened from a shortcut or a row action), DrawerContent returns focus to the element that had it when the drawer opened, as long as that element is still on the page, so keyboard users never land back at the top of the document. To pick the target yourself, pass `onCloseAutoFocus`, call `e.preventDefault()` and focus your own element.

### How do I land focus on a specific field when the drawer opens?

DrawerContent forwards Radix's `onOpenAutoFocus`, so call `e.preventDefault()` and focus your own element, for example the first Input via a ref. This keeps focus management accessible while overriding the default landing spot.

### How do I build nested views inside a bottom sheet?

Wrap your pages in `DrawerNav` with a `defaultView`, give each page a `DrawerView` keyed by `view`, then drill in with a `DrawerNavTrigger` and pop with a `DrawerNavBack`. Only the active view renders, it enters with a horizontal push, the sheet height animates to fit, and the stack resets when the drawer closes.

### What is the difference between the size and density props?

`size` caps the panel's cross-axis extent: the width of left and right panels and the height of top and bottom sheets, across four steps (`sm`, `md` default, `lg`, `xl`). `density` sets padding and the title size instead (`compact` by default, `comfortable` for roomier marketing surfaces) and re-provides itself to the header, body, and footer; drive it once via DensityProvider.

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add drawer` writes `components/ui/drawer/`. Import from `@/components/ui/drawer`:

- Components and helpers: `Drawer`, `DrawerTrigger`, `DrawerClose`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerHeader`, `DrawerBody`, `DrawerFooter`, `DrawerTitle`, `DrawerDescription`, `DrawerNav`, `DrawerView`, `DrawerNavTrigger`, `DrawerNavBack`, `useDrawerNav`, `drawerVariants`
